newsitem.title: USA: Dollar Tree Stores Q2 sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Dollar Tree Stores Q2 sales rise.

text.p: Dollar Tree Stores Inc said on Wednesday that its second quarter sales totaled $129.3 million, an increase from $102.7 million in last year's second quarter.
Year-to-date sales increased 31.7 percent, from $187.7 million to $247.1 million for the six months ended June 30, 1997, the company said in a statement.
For the second quarter of 1997, same-store sales increased 8.2 percent over the same period last year, primarily from increased shopping traffic and an increase in the average purchase per customer.
